# Enterprise Core: SAP S/4HANA (ICF/Fiori), MuleSoft Banking Shims & B2B Portals (`enterprise-sap-mulesoft-b2b`)

> **Group:** III. Enterprise, Data Lake & AI Systems
> **Product Archetypes:** Enterprise_ERP_B2B, Partner_Integration_Adapter
> **Trigger Signals:** sap, fiori, s4hana, icf, webgui, bapi, rfc, mulesoft, mule, erp, mes, dealer, b2b, immobilizer

## [ BLOCK: mulesoft-and-partner-integration-shims ]
### MuleSoft / Partner Integration Shims & High-Impact Actuation Bypass
- Audit `/external/mule/*` and B2B partner endpoints (e.g., `/immobilizer/set-bank-loaned-status`, dealer warranty/RSA APIs) that act on arrays of VINs or customer accounts.
- Verify whether partner endpoints enforce mTLS / strict client-certificate binding and per-partner tenant scoping, or if any caller with a generic token can trigger fleet-wide actions.

## [ BLOCK: sap-icf-fiori-and-erp-mes-boundary ]
### SAP Web Dispatcher, ICF Service Exposure (`/sap/public/*`, WebGUI) & L4<->L3 Boundary
- Check SAP ICF service trees for exposed ping/info/test nodes, default clients, expired TLS certs on Fiori gateways, and unauthenticated RFC/SOAP bridges between SAP ERP (ISA-95 L4) and factory MES (L3).

## [ BLOCK: b2b-batch-dos-audit-logging-and-rfc-injection ]
### B2B Batch Resource Exhaustion, ABAP/RFC Injection & Audit Trail Integrity
- Check B2B/MuleSoft bulk endpoints (e.g., VIN batch arrays, invoice sync) for missing array size limits (API4) and partial-failure transaction rollback issues.
- Verify immutable audit logging (ASVS V16) recording partner certificate subject, operator identity, and before/after state for every high-impact ERP/immobilizer action.

### Standard Mappings
- OWASP-API1:2023, OWASP-API4:2023, OWASP-API5:2023, ASVS-V13, ASVS-V16, IEC-62443-3-3

### Safe Patterns (Refutation Anchors)
- mTLS client certificate subject-DN pinned and mapped deterministically to a single partner/bank tenant ID before B2B actuation
- Per-VIN / per-contract ownership relationship verified in the database before executing immobilizer or billing state changes
- Immutable append-only audit log capturing caller identity, mTLS thumbprint, request payload hash, and approval ticket

### Vulnerable Patterns
- MuleSoft / B2B shim accepting an arbitrary array of VINs or account IDs without checking whether the authenticated partner finances/owns those assets
- SAP RFC/BAPI or OData bridge using shared static technical user credentials without propagating or validating caller authorization
- Missing batch size limits or missing audit trail on fleet-wide immobilizer, warranty, or ERP ledger mutations

### Mandatory Evidence (`required_evidence`)
- ev_... excerpt of MuleSoft/B2B controller and service logic handling partner authentication and asset/VIN authorization
- ev_... excerpt of SAP RFC/OData client configuration and audit logging call

### Verification Questions When Static Code Is Inconclusive (`questions_when_unclear`)
- Does the upstream MuleSoft API Gateway enforce mTLS certificate-to-partner-ID binding before forwarding to this service?
- Is there a human maker-checker approval workflow in SAP S/4HANA before high-value or fleet-wide commands execute?
